title: Understanding the Model Equation
text: The model equation given is $$self_{rating}=\theta_0+\theta_1 critic_1$$. This means that $$self_{rating}$$ is predicted based on a linear relationship with $$critic_1$$. Think about how changes to $$critic_1$$ might affect $$\theta_1$$.

title: Effect of Subtracting the Median
text: Subtracting the median from $$critic_1$$ shifts all values of $$critic_1$$ by a constant amount. Consider how this affects the slope $$\theta_1$$ in the linear equation.

title: Impact on $$\Theta_1$$
text: If you subtract a constant from all values of $$critic_1$$, does it change the slope of the line in the equation $$self_{rating}=\theta_0+\theta_1 critic_1$$?
